flatten_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into a flat dictionary using a separator to join keys
flatten_dict_strict: flatten a nested dictionary with strict mode to reject keys containing the separator
unflatten_dict: unflatten a flat dictionary into a nested dictionary by splitting keys on a separator
flatten_and_unflatten_roundtrip: flatten a nested dictionary and unflatten it back to verify the roundtrip works
unflatten_dict_conflict_detection: unflatten a dictionary and detect conflicts where a key is assigned both a leaf and nested value
